status.description: Whether the bundle passed every check.

manifest_schema.description: The `schema` that `bundle.json` declares, when `bundle.json` could be read and declares a well-formed schema id.

generator_matches.description: Whether the manifest's generator id equals this binary's, byte for byte in canonical form. Absent when the manifest could not be read as `prism.bundle.manifest.a3`. A bundle of another generator can be valid.

stages.description: Every stage's state as the manifest records it, in stage order (`parse`, `board`, `models`); empty when the manifest could not be read.

members_checked.description: How many members' sizes and SHA-256 digests were checked against the manifest.

findings.description:
Every failed check, sorted by `location.path` in code point order
(findings without a path first), then by `code`, then by `message`.
Empty exactly when `status` is `valid`. At most `max-findings` entries
plus one `findings-truncated`.

description: stdout of `bundle verify`: exit 0 when `status` is `valid`, exit 8 when it is `invalid`.
title: prism-kicad bundle verify report a0

SchemaId.description:
Id of a JSON document schema, `<family>.<name>.<version>`: for example
`prism.stackup.a0`, `prism.bundle.manifest.a2`, `prism.system_interface.v1`
or `kicad_monkey.design.a0`. Lowercase, dot-separated, ending in the
version (`a<N>` while pre-stable, `v<N>` once stable).

error.description: The content error that failed the stage. Present exactly when `status` is `failed`.

skip_reason.description: Why the stage will never run. Present exactly when `status` is `skipped`.

failed_members.description: The members the stage could not write, sorted by `path` in code point order. Non-empty exactly when `status` is `partial`.

CliStageState.description:
The state of one build stage: the status, error, skip reason and failed
members of the stage's record in the bundle manifest, copied verbatim. The
manifest's other per-stage fields (warnings, fill check, cross-check) are
not repeated.

Count.description: A count of things: a non-negative safe integer.

code.description: Stable code (cli-spec.md §8) that tools and tests match on.

message.description: One-sentence explanation for people. It never contains a host path; its wording may change between versions.

location.description: Where the finding is, when known.

CliFinding.description: A finding with a stable code, a message for people and an optional location.

CliBuildStage.description:
A stage of `bundle build`, in the order the stages run (ADR §4.4). The
same three stages are recorded in the bundle manifest.

CliStageStatus.description: The state of one stage in a bundle.

path.description: The member's archive path, for example `projections/system-interface.json`.

message.description: One-sentence explanation for people. It never contains a host path.

CliMemberFailure.description: A member a stage could not write, and why.

DiagnosticCode.description:
Stable machine-readable code of a finding, in lowercase kebab-case, for
example `stale-saved-fills` or `net-mismatch`. A code never changes meaning
once published; a new meaning gets a new code.

path.description:
The file, named by the path it has as a bundle member, whether or not a
bundle has been written yet: `sources/<RepoPath>` for a source file,
`refilled/<board file name>` for the `--refilled-board` input (refill mode only),
`viewer/models/components.glb` for the `--models-glb` input,
the member path itself for a member of an existing bundle. Absent when the finding
is about an argument file that is not a member (`--config`) or about no
file at all.

line.description: One-based line of the finding in a text file.

column.description: One-based column, counted in Unicode scalar values, on `line`.

offset.description: Zero-based byte offset of the finding from the start of the file.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the value in a JSON file (a `.kicad_pro`, `--config`, or a JSON member).

uuid.description: UUID of the KiCad object the finding is about, as written in the file.

CliLocation.description:
Where a finding is. Every field is optional; a field is present only when
it is known. The field names are single words so the model can move to
common.tsp unchanged and serve camelCase documents too.

ArchivePath.description:
Path of a member inside a `.prism` bundle archive: `/`-separated, relative,
no empty, `.` or `..` segment, no leading or trailing `/`, no backslash and
no `:`. The same rule as manifest a1's ArchivePath and prism-bundle's
`check_member_name`, without lookaround.

CliOneBased.description: A one-based line or column number.

ByteCount.description: A size in bytes: a non-negative safe integer.

CliJsonPointer.description:
A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into a JSON file: empty for the whole document,
otherwise `/`-separated reference tokens with `~0` for `~` and `~1` for `/`.

KiCadUuid.description:
KiCad object UUID in the canonical form KiCad writes (`KIID::AsString`):
lowercase hexadecimal, 8-4-4-4-12. Copied from the file, never generated
or re-cased.
